intro: To preach, practice, and propagate the Word of God.

title: Giving
h2: Support the Mission of True Faith Church International
intro: Your faithful giving helps True Faith Church International to preach, practice, and propagate the Word of God, and to proclaim the Gospel of Jesus Christ to all nations through Sabbath observance, prayer, and evangelism.
cards: Giving is part of our faithful service to God and humanity — supporting worship, evangelism, and the work of the ministry in every branch.
Official giving details are to be confirmed. Please contact the church office for guidance on how to give.

title: Women Commission
photos: Women of the church in worship
intro: The Women Commission encourages the women of True Faith Church International in holiness, prayer, and faithful service in the home, the church, and society.
cards: Living holy, sober, righteous, and godly lives, and upholding faithfulness and family unity.
Holiness, Prayer & Fasting, Unity & Love, and Service.
Meeting times and leaders are to be confirmed. Please contact the church office.

title: Church Administration
intro: Church Administration supports the orderly running of True Faith Church International. We believe the church is the body of Christ, guided by the Holy Scriptures, united in one faith and one purpose, and governed according to biblical principles.
cards: Order, discipline, and faithful stewardship in the life of the church.
Obedience, Discipline, Unity & Love, and Service.

title: Youth Ministry
intro: The Youth Ministry helps young people of True Faith Church International to grow in the Word of God, Christian discipline, and faithful Sabbath worship.
cards: Raising young believers who uphold the truth of God's Word through holiness and faithful Christian living.
Holiness, Obedience, Sabbath, Evangelism, and Discipline.
Meeting times and leaders are to be confirmed. Please contact the church office.

title: Evangelism Ministry
intro: We believe in preaching, practicing, and propagating the Gospel of Jesus Christ through prayer, teaching, missions, and evangelism throughout the world (Matthew 28:19–20; Mark 16:15; Acts 1:8; Romans 10:14–15).
cards: Proclaiming the Gospel of Jesus Christ to all nations through Sabbath observance, prayer, and evangelism.
From its beginnings, the ministry grew through prayer, fasting, evangelism, and baptism by immersion in rivers and streams, following the example of the early church.
Outreach programmes and leaders are to be confirmed. Please contact the church office.

title: Children's Ministry
intro: The Children's Ministry nurtures the children of True Faith Church International in the pure truth of the Kingdom of God.
cards: Teaching children the Holy Scriptures, the inspired Word of God, from an early age.
Obedience, Sabbath, Unity & Love, and Discipline.
Meeting times and leaders are to be confirmed. Please contact the church office.

title: Prophetic Ministry
photos: Members kneeling in prayer at the front
intro: We believe that the Holy Spirit works through numerous spiritual gifts and talents within the church and empowers believers for Christian life and ministry (John 14:26; Acts 1:8; 1 Corinthians 12:4–11; Galatians 5:22–23).
cards: Prayer, fasting, and obedience to the voice of God, guided by the Holy Scriptures.
Meeting times and leaders are to be confirmed. Please contact the church office.
